contentCn:
你的头有两个侧面：右侧面和左侧面。每一侧都有一块脸颊、一条眉毛、一只眼睛、一只耳朵和一个鼻孔。那么，两侧看起来一样吗？来仔细看一看。

照镜子看看自己。

你的眉毛完全一样吗？还是一边比另一边更弯？

你的两只耳朵在头部两侧完全相同的位置吗？它们的形状一样吗？

你的鼻子两侧形状一样吗？

你的头发呢？两边看起来一样吗？

你的两只眼睛形状一样吗？

现在你可能会看出脸的两侧有点不同。这是正常现象，每个人脸的两侧都不完全一样。

你身体的其他部位也不完全一样。看看你的手。其中一只是不是比另一只大？那你的脚呢？两只脚的脚趾是不是有着不同的形状？

试一试

如果你的脸两侧完全一样，你会是什么样子呢？试试看吧！找一张你的照片，像图中展示的那样，把镜子沿着鼻子放好。新“照片”看起来像你吗？把镜子转过来，看看另一侧。这张“照片”和第一张看起来一样吗？
contentEn:
Your head has two sides: a right side and a left side. Each side has a cheek, an eyebrow, an eye, an ear, and one nostril. So, do the two sides look the same? Look closely.

Look at yourself in a mirror.

Are your eyebrows exactly the same? Or is one side more curved than the other?

Are your two ears in exactly the same position on each side of your head? Are their shapes the same?

Are the two sides of your nose the same shape?

What about your hair? Do both sides look the same?

Are the shapes of your two eyes the same?

Now you may see that the two sides of your face are a little different. That is normal. No one's face is exactly the same on both sides.

Other parts of your body are not exactly the same either. Look at your hands. Is one hand bigger than the other? What about your feet? Do the toes on your two feet have different shapes?

Try It

What would you look like if both sides of your face were exactly the same? Try it! Find a photo of yourself. Place a mirror along your nose, as shown in the picture. Does the new "photo" look like you? Turn the mirror to look at the other side. Does this "photo" look the same as the first one?
